name: Jumma Masjid
description: Jumma Masjid, located in the hill town of Nuwara Eliya, is a historic mosque built by Muslim settlers during colonial times. Its architecture blends Indo-Saracenic elements with local materials, reflecting the cultural integration of early Sri Lankan Muslims. The mosque holds significant religious importance for the local Muslim community, serving as a place of worship and community gathering. It has witnessed numerous prayers and gatherings over the decades, making it a landmark of cultural heritage in the region. Visitors can also appreciate its unique blend of architectural styles, adding to its appeal as a tourist destination.

name: Hatton Jumma Mosque
description: Hatton Jumma Mosque, located in the Nuwara Eliya district of Sri Lanka, is an important Islamic landmark. Its ornate architecture and historical importance make it a must-visit site for tourists interested in Islamic heritage.
